# Pizza Volante

> Authentic wood-fired Italian pizza in Baguio City, Philippines — traditional recipes and fresh local ingredients since 2000.

Pizza Volante is a family-run pizzeria located at 082 Diego Silang St, Baguio City. We serve Neapolitan-style wood-fired pizza, pasta, and Italian classics, with both dine-in and delivery across the City of Pines.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Pizza Volante, signature dishes, and live customer review stats.
- [About](/about): Our founding story, mission, and the people behind Pizza Volante Baguio.
- [Menu](/menu): Full menu of wood-fired pizzas, pasta, salads, and sides with photos.
- [Read Reviews](/read-reviews): Verified customer reviews, ratings, and photos.
- [Leave a Review](/reviews): Submit a public review with optional photos.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, hours, phone number, and location map.
